#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Prints a greeting for the given name.
set -euo pipefail

greet() {
  local name="${1:-world}"
  if [ -n "$name" ]; then
    printf 'Hello, %s!\n' "$name"
  else
    printf 'Hello, %s!\n' "$name"
  fi
}

greet "$@"
